_comment: Live SEP-24 GET /info deposit capture (#1095), captured by hand against the anchor's own advertised transfer server the same way the sibling fixtures are. Source: https://kbtrading.org/sep24/info on 2026-09-29, which returned deposit [CLPX, BTCLN] and withdraw [CLPX (enabled: false), BTCLN]. This capture keeps the registered asset (CLPX) only, per the fixture's contract; the full response is quoted in the clpx anchor comment in constants/anchors.ts, which is also where the withdraw-disabled shape is explained. CLPX deposit being enabled here is what makes the anchor transfer-capable, and is the whole reason it is in ALLOWLIST rather than out of the registry.
